create_ImagePool: create an ImagePool instance with a specified pool size for caching generated images
query_ImagePool: query the ImagePool with a batch of images to get cached or new images back
test_ImagePool_query: test the ImagePool query method to verify it returns images from the pool or new ones
review_ImagePool_class: review the ImagePool class and its random 50% swap strategy for discriminator training
refactor_ImagePool_init: refactor the ImagePool constructor to initialize pool storage only when pool size is greater than zero
